title: BananaSMP
description: A economy plugin (like DonutSMP before the new update) for paper which adds typical features and command like random teleport a money sytems. It is perfect for grinders and crystal pvp fans and people who dont like DonutSMPs new update.
body:
# BananaSmp 
Offers a grinding and pvp based SMP expirience whit two currencies being money which can be earnd and used by trading whit the server and other players and bananacoins which is the currency use to buy spawners custom gear and generators.
## setting up:
Admins need to put a world file named world_lobby into the servers folder and if wanted can spawn NPCs whit /spawnnpc to help new player whit a better orientation. For prices and cooldowns use the plugins config to ajust. You can also use /rank to give players eighter media staff or owner rank which come whit perks like having elytra and windcharges in the lobby and being able to use /redem to redem their ranks kit. The kits for ranks and kitblocks are defineble by using /kit. Theres also commands for catching x-rayer being /spawnfakebase and /spawnfakediamond. 
## Getting started:
When you first spawn in you land in the servers lobby meet the NPCs and click on them to open their menus or just use the commands. You can acces the main world using /rtp.
## Earning money and bananacoins
To earn money collect items and sell them to the server using /sell or list them on the auction for other players to buy them using /ah sell.
to earn bananacoins you can kill players or go afk using /afk which has the downside of being unable to move and can be stopped using /afkstop but you can also earn them using playtime milestones which for axample after one hour of playtime it gives you 50 and you can
use /duel for you and your opponent to get teleported to a random location where you can fight.
## List of all commands for normal players:
Player Commands


| **Command** | **Usage** | **Description** | 
| :--- | :---: | ---: |
| /rtp | /rtp | Open random teleport GUI (choose dimension & region) | 
| /tpa | /tpa <player> | Send a teleport request | 
| /tpaccept | /tpaccept <player> | Accept a TPA request | 
| /lobby | /lobby | Return to lobby (10s countdown, cancelled in combat) | 
| /home | /sethome <name> | Set a home |
| /sethome | /home [name] | Open homes menu or go directly to a home |
| /delhome | /delhome [name] | Delete a home |
| /shop | /shop | Open the server shop (buy with money) |
| /bananashop | /bananashop | Open the banana-coin shop |
| /ah | /ah | Browse the auction house |
| /ah sell | /ah sell <price> | List the item in your hand on the AH |
| /sell | /sell [hand|all|only] | Sell items to the server |
| /pay | /pay <player> <amount> | Send money to another player |
| /duel | /duel | Join the 1v1 duel queue |
| /coinflip | /coinflip <player> <amount> | Challenge a player to a coin flip bet |
| /coinflip accept | /coinflip <player> accept | Accept a coin flip challenge |
| /bounty | /bounty <player> <amount> | Place a bounty on a player |
| /leaderboards | /leaderboards | View top players (money / bananas / playtime / bounties) |
| /team | /team <create|invite|join|leave|kick|del|sethome|home|list|glow|color> | Team management |
| /afk | /afk | afk for bananacoins | 
| /afkstop | /afkstop | stop to afk | 
| /redem | /redem | Open the rank kit redemption menu (24h cooldown per kit) | 
| /redem time | /redem time | Check remaining cooldowns for each kit | 
| /show | /show coordinates | Toggle coordinate bossbar |
| /settings | /settings | Open personal settings GUI |
| /menu | /menu | Open the quick-access overview menu |
| /rules | /rules | Show server rules |
| /bananasnpabout | /bananasnpabout | Show all player commands |
Added in 1.0.1:
| /duel | /duel <player> | Challenge a specific player to a duel |
| /duel | /duel accept <player> | Accept a duel challenge |
| /order | /order | Browse the order board — hold item & click to deliver |
| /order | /order <item> <amount> <price> | Place an item delivery order (pay-on-delivery) |
| /listed | /listed | View your AH listings & orders — click to unlist or cancel |
| /delivered| /delivered | Collect items delivered to you via orders |
| /transactions | /transactions | View recent transaction history (buys, sells, payments, bounties, shop, trades) |

If you have any concerns or want to report bug or supmit changes for improfment check out my X:
https://x.com/SpargelAlien

### Disclaimers:
This plugin was cerated for private purposes and developed started a long time ago but i decidet to upload it since i noticed that many people didnt like DonutSMPs new update as an alternative.

This plugin was not created to fully recreate some of the biggest economy servers but as my own take on it.(hope you enjoy)
